full_judgment:
Hasan Foez Siddique J.:- This Criminal Petition for Leave to Appeal by the State is directed against the judgment and order dated 13.01.2011 passed by the High Court Division in Death Reference No. 143 of 2005 analogously heard with Criminal Appeal No. 4095 of 2005, Jail Appeal Nos. 1060, 1061, 1062, and 1063 of 2005 for enhancement of sentence of the respondents from imprisonment for life to death. 

 5. The Tribunal considering the evidence of the prosecution witnesses and confessional statements of the respondents found them and another guilty. The Tribunal sent the case record in the High Court Division under section 374 of the Criminal Procedure Code for confirmation of sentence which was registered as Death Reference No. 143 of 2005. The respondents preferred aforementioned Appeals. The High Court Division commuted the sentence of the respondents from death to imprisonment for life and pay fine of Tk. 1,00000/-, in default, to suffer R.I. for 2 years. Against which, the state filed this petition for leave to appeal.
